_comment: 28 synthetic Blackboard Learn REST API term/course discovery scenarios for evaluating blackboard_sync.sync (merge_term_aliases, choose_current_terms, Syncer.discover). No real student or institutional account data. Each scenario's api_routes can be passed directly to tests.conftest.FakeBlackboard(scenario['api_routes']).

scenarios.title: First school (İSTÜN) baseline: dated Turkish terms, active Fall, past Spring, private course
scenarios.school_profile: İSTÜN (Turkey) — DateRange terms in Turkish

evaluation.why: Picks _50_1 (2026-2027 Güz) as the most recently started term, skips unavailable PHY101-1 and past term _40_1, and keeps the school's Turkish term name.
evaluation.smallest_fix: None needed; preserve via regression tests.

scenarios.title: First school (İSTÜN) bilingual duplicate term records where Turkish record holds more courses
scenarios.school_profile: İSTÜN (Turkey) — Bilingual Turkish + English term records

evaluation.why: Deduplicates _13004_1 on first sighting under _50_tr (giving _50_tr 2 courses vs _50_en 1 course), merges _50_tr and _50_en into '2026-2027 Güz', and syncs all 3 courses into one folder.
evaluation.smallest_fix: None when Turkish courses outnumber or tie-first English courses.

scenarios.title: First school (İSTÜN) bilingual term records where English-taught courses outnumber Turkish ones
scenarios.school_profile: İSTÜN (Turkey) — English-medium program with 2 English term courses and 1 Turkish term course

evaluation.why: All 3 courses are synced into a single merged folder ('2026-2027 Fall' on a fresh install, or '2026-2027 Güz' if files already exist on disk). However, if the first sync runs when all courses are still empty (no files written yet, so recorded_course_dirs is empty) and later a second Turkish course opens, the winning term name can flip before the first file is written.
evaluation.smallest_fix: Persist the chosen term folder name in state.json (or tie-break deterministically by sorted term name/id rather than API page order).

scenarios.title: Undated terms (Continuous): one term record per semester, courses created before semester
scenarios.school_profile: University with Continuous (undated) semester terms

evaluation.why: When all current courses share one undated term (_t_fa) and no older/future undated term has a newer course creation timestamp, max(c.created) (2026-08-25) accurately identifies 'Fall 2026'.
evaluation.smallest_fix: None for this clean case.

scenarios.title: Mixed dated and undated: dated Fall 2026 plus undated 'Ortak Dersler / Telafi' course created 4 days after Fall start
scenarios.school_profile: Turkish university with dated main term (2026-2027 Güz) and undated common/makeup term

evaluation.why: term_age(_50_1) is its start date 2026-09-21, whereas term_age(_ortak) is its course creation date 2026-09-25. Because 2026-09-25 > 2026-09-21, max(started) picks ONLY 'Ortak Dersler' (1 course) and completely drops '2026-2027 Güz' (all 3 main engineering courses), even though 2026-2027 Güz is actively in_date_range(now)!
evaluation.smallest_fix: Never let an undated term (t.start is None) evict a dated term that is currently in_date_range(t, now); include all dated terms where in_date_range(t, now) is True (or that overlap the latest active dated term), and only fall back to undated terms' course creation dates when no dated term is active (or include undated terms whose courses were created during the active term window).

selected_course_rel_dirs: Ortak Dersler/ATA101 Atatürk İlkeleri ve İnkılap Tarihi

scenarios.title: Mixed dated and undated: dated Fall 2026 (starts Sep 21) plus undated 'Ortak Dersler' created Aug 25
scenarios.school_profile: University where compulsory common courses sit in an undated 'Ortak Dersler' / 'Continuous' term

evaluation.why: Both _50_1 and _ortak were provisioned in late August 2026 for the same semester, but _50_1 has start=2026-09-21 while _ortak is undated (term_age=2026-08-25). Because 2026-08-25 != 2026-09-21, _ortak (TUR101) is dropped.
evaluation.smallest_fix: Include undated terms whose newest course was created within the active dated term's window (e.g. >= term.start - TERM_LEAD_TIME).

scenarios.title: Overlapping year-long and Fall semester terms starting 1 week apart (Sep 14 vs Sep 21)
scenarios.school_profile: UK / Turkish / Australian university with Full Year (2026-2027) and Semester 1 (2026-2027 Güz) terms

evaluation.why: choose_current_terms groups terms only when term_age(t) == max(started) to the exact second. Because 2026-2027 started on Sep 14 and 2026-2027 Güz started on Sep 21, the year-long term MED300 is dropped even though both terms are currently active (now=Oct 15 is inside both date ranges).
evaluation.smallest_fix: When the latest-started term is currently running (in_date_range(latest, now)), include every other term that is also currently running (in_date_range(t, now)).

scenarios.title: Year-long term (Sep 21 – Jun 30) alongside Spring semester (Feb 15 – Jun 30) during March
scenarios.school_profile: University where year-long and Fall shared Sep 21 start, now in Spring semester (March 2027)

evaluation.why: Even when the year-long term '2026-2027' started on the exact same day as '2026-2027 Güz' (Sep 21), as soon as '2026-2027 Bahar' starts on Feb 15, max(started) becomes 2027-02-15. Because the year-long term started on 2026-09-21 != 2027-02-15, the student's year-long course (CSE499) is completely dropped for the entire second semester!
evaluation.smallest_fix: Include all terms where in_date_range(t, now) is True whenever any running dated term is selected.

scenarios.title: Full 16-week Fall semester (starts Aug 24) plus 8-week Fall Block B sub-term (starts Oct 19)
scenarios.school_profile: US / UK / Australian university with modular sub-terms / 8-week blocks inside a semester

evaluation.why: On Oct 19, when the second 8-week block begins, max(started) becomes 2026-10-19 ('Fall 2026 Second 8-Week'). The student's full-semester courses (CS101, MATH201) in 'Fall 2026 Full Term' (start 2026-08-24) are immediately dropped mid-semester.
evaluation.smallest_fix: Select all terms with in_date_range(t, now) == True as part of the active group.

scenarios.title: Pre-created Spring 2027 course shells in an undated term while Fall 2026 is mid-semester
scenarios.school_profile: University with undated terms where SIS pre-creates Spring shells in November during registration

evaluation.why: Because a course's 'created' timestamp is always in the past (<= now), an undated next-term shell created on Nov 10 gets term_age = 2026-11-10 <= now. choose_current_terms puts '2026-2027 Bahar' into 'started' (not 'upcoming'!) and picks ONLY the empty Spring shell, abandoning all active Fall courses in mid-November.
evaluation.smallest_fix: Do not allow undated terms to supersede a dated term whose date range contains 'now'; and when parsing academic year/season from term names (e.g. 2026-2027 Bahar/Spring), do not treat a Spring term as started in October/November while Fall is active.

scenarios.title: Pre-created Spring 2027 term whose start date is set to November registration opening while Fall runs until Jan 31
scenarios.school_profile: Banner SIS school where Term start is set to registration/instructor-prep date (Nov 1)

evaluation.why: Because Spring 2027's start date was set to Nov 1 (registration opening), both Fall 2026 and Spring 2027 have start <= now on Nov 8. max(started) picks ONLY Spring 2027 and drops Fall 2026 six weeks before Fall ends.
evaluation.smallest_fix: Include all terms with in_date_range(t, now) == True so Fall 2026 is never dropped while its date range still contains today.

scenarios.title: Pre-created Spring 2027 shell with future start date (Feb 15, 2027) while Fall 2026 runs
scenarios.school_profile: İSTÜN / Standard DateRange school during exam weeks (Jan 20, 2027)

evaluation.why: While 2026-2027 Güz is still within its start..end range (until Jan 31), choose_current_terms keeps 2026-2027 Güz even though 2026-2027 Bahar starts within 30 days.
evaluation.smallest_fix: None needed for this case.

scenarios.title: Old undated term ('2025-2026 Yaz Stajı') gets a late-created evaluation shell in Oct 2026
scenarios.school_profile: University where summer internship evaluation shell is created in October under the Summer term

evaluation.why: Because '2025-2026 Yaz' has no start date, its term_age is the creation date of CSE300-1 (2026-10-05), which is newer than 2026-2027 Güz's start date (2026-09-21). choose_current_terms picks ONLY '2025-2026 Yaz' and drops '2026-2027 Güz'.
evaluation.smallest_fix: Prefer terms whose DateRange contains 'now' over undated terms; also use academic year/season order when term names encode it (2026-2027 Güz > 2025-2026 Yaz).

scenarios.title: Archived term in state.past_terms with a late-created course wins choose_current_terms then gets filtered out as frozen
scenarios.school_profile: Existing user whose state.json has past_terms={'_40_1': ...} and an admin adds a late course to _40_1

evaluation.why: choose_current_terms runs BEFORE frozen past_terms are excluded! _40_1 wins choose_current_terms (because 2026-10-05 > 2026-09-21), and then run_sync (line 1322) removes _40_1 because it is in state.past_terms and not in_date_range, leaving ZERO terms and ZERO courses ('No courses found on Blackboard')!
evaluation.smallest_fix: Exclude frozen terms (set(t.ids) & set(state.past_terms) and not in_date_range(t, now)) BEFORE calling choose_current_terms in Syncer.discover().

scenarios.title: Courses with no term (termId null) alongside active Fall 2026 term
scenarios.school_profile: University with termless orientation/library course plus dated semester courses

evaluation.why: Includes termless courses in 'No term' alongside '2026-2027 Güz'. Minor risk: if a student has old termless courses from prior years still marked available='Yes', those also sync until unticked.
evaluation.smallest_fix: None required for active termless courses.

scenarios.title: School lists one undated term per course section (2026FA-CS101-01, 2026FA-MATH201-01, 2026FA-PHYS101-01)
scenarios.school_profile: SIS integration that creates a separate Continuous Term record per course section

evaluation.why: Each undated section term takes its course's millisecond creation timestamp (09:01:10Z, 09:01:25Z, 09:01:40Z). Because starting_at(max(started)) checks exact equality (term_age(t) == age), it picks ONLY PHYS101 (09:01:40Z) and drops CS101 and MATH201 (which were created 15 and 30 seconds earlier in the same SIS batch)!
evaluation.smallest_fix: For undated terms, group terms whose newest course creation date falls within the same batch/semester window (e.g. within 45 days of the newest undated term's course creation date), or share the same term-code prefix.

scenarios.title: School lists one dated term per course section starting on each section's first lecture day (Mon/Tue/Wed)
scenarios.school_profile: University where each section term's start date is its first class meeting (Sep 21, Sep 22, Sep 23)

evaluation.why: Because the three section terms start on Sep 21, Sep 22, and Sep 23, max(started) is 2026-09-23 and starting_at(max(started)) picks ONLY '2026 Fall - PHYS101', dropping Monday and Tuesday courses.
evaluation.smallest_fix: Include all dated terms where in_date_range(t, now) is True.

scenarios.title: Term with wrong dates: admin cloned '2025-2026 Güz' to '2026-2027 Güz' but left start year as 2025
scenarios.school_profile: University where admin forgot to update the cloned term's start/end year from 2025 to 2026

evaluation.why: Because '2026-2027 Güz' has a stale start date of 2025-09-21 (older than its own courses created in Aug 2026!), term_age(_50_1) is 2025-09-21 < term_age(_40_1) = 2026-02-09. Both terms have end < now, so choose_current_terms picks last semester ('2025-2026 Bahar') and drops '2026-2027 Güz'!
evaluation.smallest_fix: If a term's courses were all created after term.end (or after term.start + 180 days), its DateRange is stale/wrong: use max(term.start, newest_course_created) or ignore the stale DateRange.

scenarios.title: Two conventions in one account: dated '2026-2027 Güz' plus Banner-coded undated '2026FA (Fall 2026)'
scenarios.school_profile: Joint degree / consortium or university migrating SIS naming mid-year

evaluation.why: academic_term('2026FA - Fall 2026') is None (only matches YYYY-YYYY Season), so merge_term_aliases does not merge them, and choose_current_terms drops '2026FA - Fall 2026' because its course creation date (2026-09-01) is earlier than 2026-2027 Güz's start date (2026-09-21).
evaluation.smallest_fix: Include undated terms whose courses were created within the active term's lead-time/date window, and scope desktop state.json by school host so switching schools never collides on primary keys.

scenarios.title: Switching from İSTÜN to KSU on desktop: unscoped state.json maps KSU's _13004_1 into İSTÜN's '2026-2027 Güz' folder
scenarios.school_profile: Student or tester switching base_url from istun.edu.tr to lms.ksu.edu.sa

evaluation.why: Because state.json is not scoped by base_url, recorded_course_dirs() sees _13004_1 in state.outputs under '2026-2027 Güz/CSE303 Algorithm Analysis'. assign_term_folders() assigns KSU's term folder to '2026-2027 Güz' and places KSU's ARAB101 course inside '2026-2027 Güz/CSE303 Algorithm Analysis'!
evaluation.smallest_fix: Scope state.json and courses.json by normalized base_url host (or store base_url in state.json and ignore/reset recorded paths when base_url changes).

scenarios.title: Blackboard Organizations (organization: true) returned by /users/{userId}/courses hijack current term
scenarios.school_profile: University where students belong to clubs/advising communities (Blackboard Organizations)

evaluation.why: GET /learn/api/public/v1/users/{userId}/courses returns both Courses and Organizations (marked with course.organization == True). Syncer.discover() does not filter out organization == True. Because 'IEEE Student Branch' sits in an undated 'Organizations' term and was created on Oct 1 (after Sep 21), 'Organizations' wins max(started) and drops all academic courses in '2026-2027 Güz'!
evaluation.smallest_fix: In Syncer.discover(), skip memberships where course.get('organization') is True (or pass organization=false to the memberships query and also filter client-side).

scenarios.title: First-year student in early September before any term has started (Fall 2026 and Spring 2027 upcoming)
scenarios.school_profile: First-year student logging in on Sep 5 before Sep 21 Fall start

evaluation.why: When started is empty and both terms have future start dates, min(upcoming) picks the first upcoming term ('2026-2027 Güz').
evaluation.smallest_fix: None needed for this clean case.

scenarios.title: First-year student 10 days before Fall starts, with an undated August Orientation term
scenarios.school_profile: First-year student on Sep 11 (10 days before Sep 21 Fall start) who had an August Orientation course

evaluation.why: On Sep 11 (10 days before Fall starts, well within TERM_LEAD_TIME=30 days), _50_1 is already open (in_date_range(_50_1, now) is True!). However, _ori is undated (term_age=2026-08-20 <= now, t.end=None), so 'started' is [_ori]. Line 225 checks 'all(t.end and t.end < now for t in group)', which is False because _ori.end is None! So the upcoming Fall term never takes over until Sep 21.
evaluation.smallest_fix: Treat any dated term with in_date_range(t, now) == True (which already includes the 30-day lead time) as active, or allow an upcoming dated term within TERM_LEAD_TIME to take over from an undated term.

scenarios.title: Saudi university (KSU/UQU style) returning Arabic and English Hijri term records ('1448 الفصل الأول' and '1448 First Semester')
scenarios.school_profile: Saudi university in SCHOOLS (lms.ksu.edu.sa / lms.uqu.edu.sa) withHijri terms

evaluation.why: ACADEMIC_TERM only matches 4-digit Gregorian ranges 'YYYY-YYYY <Turkish/English season>'. It returns None for Hijri years ('1448') and Arabic seasons ('الفصل الدراسي الأول' / 'First Semester'). Thus merge_term_aliases leaves them unmerged, and because they are undated with course creation dates 1 day apart (Aug 20 vs Aug 21), choose_current_terms drops the entire Arabic term (IC101, ARAB101) and syncs only CSC111!
evaluation.smallest_fix: Extend academic_term() to recognize single-year and Hijri/Gregorian semester patterns (including Arabic 'الفصل الأول/الثاني/الصيفي' and 'First/Second/Summer Semester' / 'Semester 1/2'), and group undated terms created in the same semester window.

scenarios.title: Course has availability.available='Term' while its Term has availability.available='No' (closed/pre-created term)
scenarios.school_profile: University that controls course access at the Term level (course.availability.available='Term')

evaluation.why: In Blackboard REST API, course.availability.available == 'Term' means the course inherits its availability from term.availability.available. Syncer.discover() never checks term.availability.available (nor 'Disabled' on membership/course), so it includes the unavailable _60_1 term, which then beats _50_1 via its Nov 10 course creation date!
evaluation.smallest_fix: Skip memberships/courses whose availability.available is in ('No', 'Disabled'), and when course.availability.available == 'Term' (or always), skip terms whose availability.available is in ('No', 'Disabled').

scenarios.title: Turkish university naming bilingual terms '2026-2027 Eğitim-Öğretim Yılı Güz Dönemi' and '2026-2027 Academic Year Fall Semester'
scenarios.school_profile: Turkish university using full official title in Blackboard term names

evaluation.why: ACADEMIC_TERM requires the season word immediately after the years ('2026-2027 <season>'). Because 'Eğitim-Öğretim Yılı' / 'Academic Year' sits between the years and 'Güz'/'Fall', academic_term() returns None. When dated identically, both terms are selected without merging, creating two separate semester folders ('2026-2027 Eğitim-Öğretim Yılı Güz Dönemi' and '2026-2027 Academic Year Fall Semester'); when undated, one of the two folders is dropped completely!
evaluation.smallest_fix: Allow optional words like 'Eğitim-Öğretim Yılı', 'Akademik Yılı', 'Academic Year' in ACADEMIC_TERM.

selected_course_rel_dirs: 2026-2027 Eğitim-Öğretim Yılı Güz Dönemi/CSE303 Algoritma Analizi
2026-2027 Academic Year Fall Semester/CSE331 Operating Systems

scenarios.title: No term has start/end dates and no course has a 'created' timestamp
scenarios.school_profile: Blackboard server omitting term DateRange and course.created

evaluation.why: When known is empty (every term has term_age == UNDATED), choose_current_terms falls back to returning ALL terms ([2025-2026 Bahar, 2026-2027 Güz]), even though the term names clearly show 2026-2027 Güz is newer than 2025-2026 Bahar. Safe against missing courses, but downloads all past terms silently if there is no first-sync confirmation.
evaluation.smallest_fix: Show a first-download confirmation when multiple terms are selected or when falling back to all terms, and use parsed academic year/season order as a tie-breaker before downloading everything.

scenarios.title: Cross-listed master/parent course in undated 'Default Term' (created Aug 15) while empty child section is in dated 'Fall 2026'
scenarios.school_profile: University where merged/cross-listed parent shells are created in 'Default Term'

evaluation.why: The student's membership in the parent container (_13000_1, which has childCourseId='_13004_1' and holds the actual lecture files) sits in 'Default Term' (undated, created Aug 15). Because 2026-08-15 < 2026-09-21, choose_current_terms drops 'Default Term' and only syncs the empty child section in 'Fall 2026'.
evaluation.smallest_fix: If a membership has childCourseId pointing to a course in a selected current term (or is a parent of a selected course), include that parent course with the current term.
